newsitem.title: USA: FoxMeyer Chapter 11 hearing set for March.
newsitem.headline: FoxMeyer Chapter 11 hearing set for March.

text.p: FoxMeyer Health Corp said Monday that the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware will hold a creditor's committee hearing on March 5. The court is presiding over the Chapter 11 bankruptcy of certain FoxMayer subsidiaries.
The company said the subject of the hearing would be the disposal and transfer of some of its assets.

In a separate statement, the company said that in two to three weeks it is changing its name to Avatex Corp as part of its agreement to sell the assets of its FoxMeyer Drug Co subsidiary in late 1996.
